from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,os,stat
targets=[Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads'),Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads'),Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads')]
interesting={'users.db','estado_bot.json','telethon_adder.log','supervisor-events.jsonl','operation-state.json'}
suffixes={'.db','.db3','.sqlite','.sqlite3','.jsonl','.log','.tgz','.gz','.zip'}
for base in targets:
 print('SCOPED_ROOT',str(base))
 found=[];visited=0
 for root,dirs,files in os.walk(base,followlinks=False):
  here=Path(root); rel=here.relative_to(base)
  if len(rel.parts)>=4:
   dirs[:]=[]
  else:
   dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in ('.venv','node_modules','.git','__pycache__') and not (here/d).is_symlink()]
  for name in files:
   visited+=1
   p=here/name
   if p.is_symlink():continue
   if name in interesting or p.suffix.lower() in suffixes or 'backup' in name.lower():
    try: size=p.stat().st_size
    except OSError:continue
    found.append((str(p),size))
 print('FILES_SCANNED',visited)
 print('HISTORY_CANDIDATES',found[:75])
 print('CANDIDATE_COUNT',len(found))
journal=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl')
if journal.is_file() and not journal.is_symlink():
 schema=Counter();typings=Counter();type_values=Counter();total=0;first=None;last=None
 for line in journal.open(encoding='utf-8'):
  total+=1
  try: v=json.loads(line)
  except ValueError: continue
  if not isinstance(v,dict):continue
  if first is None:first=v
  last=v
  schema[','.join(sorted(v.keys()))]+=1
  for field in ('status','event','event_type','kind','type','action'):
   if field not in v:continue
   val=v[field]
   if isinstance(val,str) and len(val)<95:type_values[(field,val)]+=1
   else:typings[(field,type(val).__name__)]+=1
 print('JOURNAL_COUNT',total)
 print('JOURNAL_SCHEMAS',schema.most_common(7))
 print('JOURNAL_EVENT_FIELDS',type_values.most_common(35))
 print('JOURNAL_VALUE_TYPES',typings.most_common(12))
 print('FIRST_FIELD_NAMES',sorted(first.keys()) if first else [])
 print('LAST_FIELD_NAMES',sorted(last.keys()) if last else [])
print('EVIDENCE_AUDIT_COMPLETE')
PY
